mechanics.claim: Naafiri dashes and deals damage to enemies she passes through during the dash, then deals separate flurry damage to nearby enemies on arrival.
mechanics.quote: dashes in the target direction and deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies she passes through. Upon arrival, she explodes in a flurry of blades to deal {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies.

mechanics.claim: The dash damage and flurry damage are two separate damage instances that can both hit the same target.
mechanics.quote: deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies she passes through. Upon arrival, she explodes in a flurry of blades to deal {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies.

mechanics.claim: Eviscerate can be blocked by a spell shield.
Packmates do not vanish/reappear or gain the full heal from this ability while under Hounds' Pursuit's effect.
mechanics.quote: ''Packmates'' will not be affected by ''Eviscerate'' while under the effect of ''{{ai|Hounds' Pursuit|Naafiri}}''.
